scope: Theorem 2.3 (Uniform fractional mean) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose a(k) > 0, and let um be the uniform probability on Bm. Then (h, um) modulo 2π converges to uniform measure on the circle, independently of the Gaussian observations in Theorem 2.2 on a square. More generally, for every fixed l ∈ Z \ {0} and every sequence of zero-total profiles tm of uniformly bounded bare inverse energy, wBm (lum + tm) −→ 0. (2.17)
